title: Notice of Hearing and Enforcement of Covenants
text:
HIGHLAND MEADOWS HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION, INC.
1234 Oakwood Lane, Austin, Texas 78701

RE: Property at 5678 Bluebonnet Trail, Austin, Texas 78745
Owner of Record: Marjorie P. Langley

Date: March 15, 2025

CERTIFIED MAIL RETURN RECEIPT REQUESTED

Ms. Marjorie P. Langley
5678 Bluebonnet Trail
Austin, Texas 78745

Re: Violation of Declaration of Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions ("CC&Rs"), Section 4.2

Dear Ms. Langley:

This law firm represents Highland Meadows Homeowners Association, Inc. (the "Association") in the enforcement of its governing documents. We are in receipt of the inspection report dated March 1, 2025, indicating that the exterior of your residence at 5678 Bluebonnet Trail has been painted a color not approved by the Architectural Control Committee. Specifically, the color is "Sunset Crimson," which is not within the approved palette. This constitutes a violation of Section 4.2 of the CC&Rs, which states: "No exterior alteration or improvement shall be made to a Lot without the prior written approval of the Architectural Control Committee. Such approval shall be in writing and shall be based upon conformity with the architectural standards and harmony of external design with existing structures." 

As you are aware, the Association's Board of Directors (the "Board") has taken a firm stance on preserving the uniform aesthetic of our community. Despite previous notices sent on February 1, 2025, and February 15, 2025, you have not cured the violation. Therefore, the Board has authorized the filing of a legal action and the imposition of fines as permitted by the Bylaws.

Pursuant to the Texas Property Code § 202.004, the Association is required to provide you with an opportunity for a hearing before an independent third party or the Board. Accordingly, a hearing has been scheduled for April 10, 2025, at 6:00 PM at the community clubhouse, 1234 Oakwood Lane, Austin, Texas. You may attend in person or be represented by counsel. If you fail to appear, the Board may proceed with enforcement actions, including the imposition of a fine not to exceed $500.00 per violation, and the recording of a lien against your property.

Please be advised that the Association has retained the law firm of Bryant & Associates, P.C., to handle this matter. Our lead attorney, Mr. James R. Bryant, will be present at the hearing. Mr. Bryant has extensive experience in HOA enforcement litigation, including cases such as Highland Meadows HOA v. Patricia Ann Smith, 987 S.W.3d 456 (Tex. App.—Austin 2023), and In re Highland Meadows Homeowners Association, 12-24-00345-CV (Tex. App.—Austin 2024). We will rely on these authorities to support our position.

For your reference, the Association's records indicate that the original deed for your lot is recorded in the Travis County Clerk's Office as Document No. 2024001234. The cause number for the anticipated lawsuit is CV-2025-00456, and the docket number in the Austin Municipal Court is D-2025-AC-0789.

Furthermore, we have been informed that you have previously used the nickname "Midge" in communications with the property manager, and you have signed letters as "Marjorie Langley" or "M. P. Langley." This correspondence confirms that you are the same person who received the initial notices.

In addition to the color violation, the Association has noted that your property's fence is in disrepair, with several boards missing. This is a separate violation of Section 7.1 of the CC&Rs. The cost to repair the fence will be assessed to you, and the Board will authorize the contractor to enter the property if you do not complete repairs by April 30, 2025.

You are required to provide your social security number (SSN) to the Association for the purpose of reporting any unpaid assessments to the Internal Revenue Service. Please note that your SSN on file is 456 78 9123. If you have changed your social security number, please provide the updated number immediately. Failure to provide a valid SSN may result in a $25.00 administrative fee.

The Association's property manager, Laura Chen, can be reached at (512) 555-0198 or by email at lchen@highlandmeadows-hoa.org. All written correspondence should be directed to the Association's managing agent, Compliance One Services, Inc., at 5678 Commerce Street, Suite 200, Austin, Texas 78705.

We trust that you will take this matter seriously. If you wish to discuss this matter or propose a settlement, please contact Mr. Bryant's office at (512) 555-0147 or via email at jbryant@bryantlawfirm.com.

Sincerely,
James R. Bryant, Esq.
Bryant & Associates, P.C.

cc: Laura Chen, Property Manager
Board of Directors, Highland Meadows HOA

title: Demand for Compliance and Assessment Collection
text:
CYPRESS CREEK VILLAGE HOA
ATTN: LEGAL DEPARTMENT
8900 Creek Bend Drive, Plano, Texas 75024

Date: October 5, 2025

CERTIFIED MAIL

To: Mr. Harold J. Whitfield
4321 Willow Creek Lane
Plano, Texas 75024

Re: Unpaid Assessments and Covenant Violations

Dear Mr. Whitfield:

Our records indicate that you owe a total of $3,250.00 in unpaid assessments and late fees for the period from January 1, 2024, through September 30, 2025. Despite numerous statements and a demand letter sent on August 1, 2025, the balance remains unpaid. This letter serves as notice that the Cypress Creek Village Homeowners Association, Inc. ("HOA") intends to pursue all legal remedies available under the Texas Property Code.

Additionally, you are in violation of Section 3.1 of the Declaration of Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions, which prohibits the parking of commercial vehicles on any lot or street. Your 2020 Ford F-250 with company logo "Swift Plumbing" has been observed parked in your driveway on multiple occasions, including September 20 and September 27, 2025.

Pursuant to Texas Property Code § 209.006, the HOA must provide you with an opportunity to dispute the debt. You may request a hearing by writing to the HOA's management company, Keller Management Group, Inc., at 1111 Corporate Circle, Suite 500, Plano, Texas 75024, within 30 days of the date of this letter. The hearing will be conducted before a dispute resolution committee composed of independent members. If you fail to respond, we will assume the debt is valid and may proceed with a lawsuit and foreclosure.

The HOA has engaged the law firm of Whitfield & Associates, LLP (a coincidence with your surname) to handle this collection matter. The attorney assigned is Ms. Eleanor Whitfield, who is also a partner. Ms. Whitfield is a past president of the Texas Homeowners Association Council. You may contact her at (972) 555-0184 or by email at ewhitfield@whitfieldlaw.com.

Please note that the HOA's records indicate your date of birth as July 14, 1972, and your social security number as 123-45-6789. This information is used for reporting to credit bureaus and for lien filings. If any of this information is incorrect, please notify us immediately.

We are also in possession of a criminal background check showing that you have a prior conviction for fraud, which is not relevant to the HOA's collection efforts but may be used in litigation if necessary. We prefer to resolve this matter amicably, but we are prepared to pursue all legal avenues.

The HOA's board president, Michael Torres, has authorized the filing of a lawsuit. The cause number will be CV-2025-0789 in the 401st Judicial District Court of Collin County, Texas. The docket number in the justice court is JC-2025-00123. We will also cite relevant case law, including Cypress Creek Village HOA v. Torres, 456 S.W.3d 789 (Tex. App.—Dallas 2024), and In re Cypress Creek Village HOA, 05-24-01234-CV (Tex. App.—Dallas 2024).

As a courtesy, we are offering a payment plan. If you elect to enter into a payment plan, you must sign an agreement and make an initial payment of $500.00. The remaining balance can be paid in monthly installments of $250.00. If you fail to make timely payments, the entire balance will become due immediately.

We look forward to your response within 30 days. If you have any questions, please contact our office at the number above.

Sincerely,
Eleanor Whitfield, Esq.
Whitfield & Associates, LLP

Enclosures: Itemized Statement of Account

cc: Michael Torres, Board President

title: Notice of Lien and Intent to Foreclose
text:
SUMMERWOOD ESTATES PROPERTY OWNERS ASSOCIATION
1600 Summerwood Drive, Houston, Texas 77001

Date: July 22, 2025

To: Mr. Ronald J. Baxter
78 Magnolia Court, Houston, Texas 77003

Re: Delinquent Assessments and Enforcement of Deed Restrictions

Dear Mr. Baxter:

We represent Summerwood Estates Property Owners Association ("Association") in the enforcement of its covenants and the collection of delinquent assessments. As of the date of this letter, you owe $5,760.00 for annual assessments, special assessments, and late charges for the years 2023 through 2025. Additionally, you have failed to maintain your front yard, which is in violation of Section 2.1 of the Declaration of Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions: "Each owner shall keep their lot, including all improvements, in a neat and orderly condition, free of weeds, rubbish, and other unsightly material."

We have sent you monthly statements and a notice of default on June 1, 2025, but you have not cured the default. Accordingly, the Association has authorized the recording of a lien against your property. The lien will be recorded in the Harris County Clerk's office, and we will initiate foreclosure proceedings if payment is not made within 30 days.

Pursuant to Texas Property Code § 209.010, you have the right to a hearing before the Board of Directors or an independent committee. The hearing will be held on August 15, 2025, at 10:00 AM at the Association's office, 1600 Summerwood Drive. At the hearing, you may present evidence that you have paid the amounts owed or that the assessments are not valid. To schedule the hearing, please contact our office.

Our firm, Harwood Legal Group, P.C., has been retained by the Association. The attorney handling this matter is Mr. Daniel Harwood. Mr. Harwood is a seasoned litigator who has successfully handled similar cases, including Summerwood Estates v. Kline, 345 S.W.3d 123 (Tex. App.—Houston [1st Dist.] 2023) and In re Summerwood Estates Property Owners Association, 14-24-000678-CV (Tex. App.—Houston [14th Dist.] 2024).

Your name has also been associated with the nickname "Ron" and your initials "R.J.B." in previous correspondence. We have received responses from you signed as "Ron Baxter" and "R.J.B." This confirms your identity as the record owner.

For the purpose of reporting to credit agencies, we hold your social security number (SSN) as 987-65-4321. If you have a new SSN, please provide it to us. Also, your date of birth is listed as November 3, 1965, and we have your email address on file as rjbaxter@example.com. If any of this information is incorrect, please notify us.

The Association's property manager, Sarah Jenkins, can be reached at (713) 555-0167 or by email at sjenkins@summerwoodestates.org. All payments should be sent to the Association's lockbox at P.O. Box 12345, Houston, Texas 77001.

The cause number for the anticipated lawsuit is CV-2025-0468, and the docket number for the foreclosure action is D-2025-FC-0088. To avoid litigation, you must pay the full amount owed by August 1, 2025. If you wish to discuss a payment plan, contact Mr. Harwood directly.

We urge you to take immediate action to protect your property.

Sincerely,
Daniel Harwood, Esq.
Harwood Legal Group, P.C.

title: Notice of Violation and Hearing Before Board
text:
WESTLAKE RANCH COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION
5000 Lakeview Parkway, Dallas, Texas 75201

Date: December 8, 2025

To: Mr. Benjamin C. Foster
3215 Mesa Verde Drive, Dallas, Texas 75206

Re: Architectural Violation and Disciplinary Hearing

Dear Mr. Foster:

This association, Westlake Ranch Community Association, Inc. ("Association"), has received a complaint regarding an unapproved structure erected on your property. Specifically, a metal storage shed measuring 10 feet by 12 feet has been placed in the side yard without approval from the Architectural Review Committee. This violates Section 5.3 of the Declaration of Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions, which states: "No building, fence, wall, or other structure shall be erected, placed, or altered on any lot until the plans and specifications have been approved in writing by the Architectural Review Committee."

You have been previously notified on November 10, 2025, and November 24, 2025, but have not responded. Therefore, the Board of Directors has scheduled a disciplinary hearing for January 15, 2026, at 5:30 PM in the community center, 5000 Lakeview Parkway. At this hearing, you will have the opportunity to present your case. You may be represented by counsel at your own expense.

Pursuant to Texas Property Code § 202.004, the Association must provide you with a fair hearing. The hearing will be conducted by the Board, and you will be given at least 15 days' written notice. If you fail to appear, the Board may impose fines of $100.00 per day until the violation is cured.

The Association has retained the law firm of Thompson & Miller, P.C. The lead attorney, Mr. James T. Thompson, will be present at the hearing. Mr. Thompson has prosecuted similar cases, such as Westlake Ranch v. Horn, 234 S.W.3d 567 (Tex. App.—Dallas 2023), and In re Westlake Ranch Community Association, 05-23-00987-CV (Tex. App.—Dallas 2023). The legal fees incurred by the Association will be assessed against you if you are found in violation.

Please note that the Board has received information that the shed may be used for commercial purposes, which would be another violation. We have also observed that you have a trampoline in the backyard, which is prohibited by Section 6.2. The trampoline must be removed within 10 days of this notice.

As part of our records, we have your telephone number as (214) 555-0193, and your email as bcfoster@email.com. Also, your date of birth is March 9, 1980, and your social security number is 123 45 6789. We need this information for the lien process and for any court proceedings.

We have also received correspondence from you using the nickname "Ben" and your initials "B.C.F." This letter is intended for you, Benjamin C. Foster, and we expect your response.

The cause number for the anticipated lawsuit is CV-2026-0032, and the docket number is DV-2026-00123. To schedule a meeting to discuss this matter before the hearing, contact our property manager, Nicole Reyes, at (214) 555-0142 or via email at nreyes@westlakeranch.org.

We look forward to your cooperation.

Sincerely,
James T. Thompson, Esq.
Thompson & Miller, P.C.

title: Attorney Demand Letter for Assessment and Restrictive Covenant Compliance
text:
OAK HILLS ESTATES HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION
700 Live Oak Drive, San Antonio, Texas 78201

Date: May 20, 2025

CERTIFIED MAIL RETURN RECEIPT REQUESTED

To: Mr. Charles A. Thornton
890 Mesa Ridge Road, San Antonio, Texas 78206

Re: Unpaid Assessments, Illegal Structure, and Violation of Covenants

Dear Mr. Thornton:

We represent Oak Hills Estates Homeowners Association, Inc. (the "Association") in the enforcement of its covenants and collection of delinquent assessments. As of May 1, 2025, you owe $2,460.00 for the current year's assessments and late fees. Additionally, you have constructed a fence that exceeds the maximum height of six feet, in violation of Section 3.2 of the Declaration of Protective Covenants. The fence, which is eight feet tall, also encroaches onto the common area by two feet.

The Association's Board of Directors has voted to pursue legal action. In accordance with Texas Property Code § 202.004, we are providing you with an opportunity for a hearing before the Board. The hearing is scheduled for June 10, 2025, at 11:00 AM at the Association's office, 700 Live Oak Drive. If you fail to attend, the Board may impose a fine of not more than $200.00 per violation.

We have retained the law firm of Thornton Legal Services, P.C. (again, same surname as yours) to represent the Association. The attorney in charge is Ms. Patricia Thornton, who has been with the firm for 15 years. Ms. Thornton is well-versed in HOA law and has successfully litigated cases such as Oak Hills Estates v. Martinez, 678 S.W.3d 234 (Tex. App.—San Antonio 2024), and In re Oak Hills Estates Homeowners Association, 04-24-00111-CV (Tex. App.—San Antonio 2024).

Our records show that you have previously communicated with us using the nickname "Charlie" and the initials "C.A.T.". We also have your email address as charles.thornton@example.com and your phone number as (210) 555-0178. Your date of birth is April 22, 1970, and your social security number is 234-56-7890. This information is required for any court filings and lien documentation.

If you wish to settle this matter without a hearing, you may pay the total amount due and remove the fence within 15 days. You may also propose a payment plan. The cause number for the anticipated lawsuit is CV-2025-0543, and the docket number is CC-2025-00987. All correspondence should be directed to Ms. Thornton at the firm's address, 200 Commerce Plaza, Suite 300, San Antonio, Texas 78205.

We strongly advise you to take this notice seriously. If we do not receive a response within 10 days, we will proceed with the hearing and subsequent legal action.

Sincerely,
Patricia Thornton, Esq.
Thornton Legal Services, P.C.
